en: A faded sepia-toned image showing a crowded harbor scene. A large steamship with a tall funnel is docked on the left, with passengers and crew visible on deck. An enormous striped flag or pennant rises beside the ship. On the quay, hundreds of people in early-20th‑century clothing gather around, some walking along rails embedded in the ground. A small harbor building with a gabled roof stands in the middle distance, and masts or sails of other vessels can be seen to the right. The lower left foreground has been overpainted with dark blue brushstrokes. The photograph appears to be printed as a postcard, but no legible caption or writing is visible on the image side.
